purpose: Synthetic-only validation of a tuning-parameter-free self-normalized interval for the future Alpha v5 date-level mean statistics after v1 and v2 block-bootstrap intervals substantively failed their frozen null-coverage contracts.

nullConstruction.outcome: Forward sums of synthetic daily shared plus idiosyncratic shocks over exactly H sessions, sampled every five sessions.
nullConstruction.predictors: Generated from a separately spawned RNG stream and independent of every target innovation.
nullConstruction.pairedForecastContrast: Two exchangeable independent synthetic forecast streams with the same scale; expected paired MSE difference is exactly zero by symmetry.
nullConstruction.selection: Top 20 percent of names by an independent synthetic selection score; expected selected mean and selected-minus-universe mean are zero.
nullConstruction.rankStatistic: Within-date rank correlation between an independent synthetic score and target; population value is zero.

intervalConstruction.normalizer: W_n = n^-2 * sum_{t=1}^n (S_t - (t/n) S_n)^2, where S_t is the prefix sum of the date-level statistic
intervalConstruction.criticalValueSource: Lobato (2001) U1 pivotal distribution; independently reproduced table reports q=1 upper critical value 66.57 at 97.5%. Shao (2010) gives the recursive-estimate self-normalized confidence-region construction and identifies it as Bartlett fixed-b with b=1.

acceptance.failureRule: If any registered statistic violates any frozen tolerance in any DGP/depth/horizon cell, calibration is FAIL. Do not alter the pivotal critical value, calendar depth, DGP, statistic, seed, or tolerance after viewing results under this contract.
acceptance.interpretationRule: PASS validates only synthetic null size/coverage behavior for this self-normalized interval. It does not establish historical Alpha, profitability, deployability, stationarity of real returns, or power against economically relevant alternatives.

v1FailureReference.reason: Non-circular moving-block percentile/basic mechanics materially undercover under the registered nulls.

v2FailureReference.reason: Circular moving-block basic intervals still materially undercover in every primary cell; all registered sensitivity block lengths also had zero fully passing cells.

prohibitions: No historical return, label, score, prediction, result report, signal-history outcome artifact, or Alpha experiment may be read.
No simulation parameter may be estimated from real returns.
No v1 or v2 sensitivity block performance may select or tune v3 because v3 has no block-length parameter.
The U1 critical value is fixed from the published pivotal distribution and may not be inflated or reduced after viewing v3 calibration results.
No seed, DGP, tolerance, calendar depth, statistic, or replication budget may be changed after viewing v3 calibration results under this contract.
No historical outcome may be accessed before v3 is closed and the later v5 preregistration is separately frozen.
No v5 preregistration or seal is created by this calibration protocol.
